message.content: The background is indeed dark, utilizing a deep navy or charcoal color scheme rather than a light theme. The top bar maintains a very dark navy appearance with crisp white text for high readability. The sidebar on the left uses a slightly lighter shade of dark gray or navy, providing clear visual separation from the main content area. The main content cards feature a dark blue-gray background with excellent text contrast, using white for headings and lighter gray for secondary information. The gold accent color remains highly prominent and vibrant, effectively highlighting the "Start Lesson" button, statistics numbers, and chapter badge against the dark surroundings. Overall, the aesthetic is perfectly coherent with a professional dark mode dashboard, offering a sleek, modern, and visually comfortable user experience that aligns with high-quality educational platform designs.
